item.text: [{"task_id":"1a244afd","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    anchor = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    result_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    alignment = int(round(params['alignment'][0]))","    rotation = params['rotation']","    result = grid.copy()","    result[grid == marker] = background","    markers = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    anchors = np.argwhere(grid == anchor)","    for position in anchors:","        best = None","        distance = None","        for candidate in markers:","            dr = int(candidate[0] - position[0])","            dc = int(candidate[1] - position[1])","            if abs(dr) == alignment or abs(dc) == alignment:","                current = abs(dr) + abs(dc)","                if distance is None or current < distance:","                    distance = current","                    best = (dr, dc)","        if best is not None:","            dr, dc = best","            row = int(position[0]) + int(round(rotation[0, 0] * dr + rotation[0, 1] * dc))","            col = int(position[1]) + int(round(rotation[1, 0] * dr + rotation[1, 1] * dc))","            if 0 <= row < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= col < grid.shape[1]:","                result[row, col] = result_color","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"alignment":[1],"rotation":[2,2]},"params":{"colors":[8,1,6,7],"alignment":[0],"rotation":[[0,-1],[1,0]]},"rationale":"Each blue anchor pairs with its nearest row- or column-aligned magenta marker.
